source: Valentine & Zoelle (2022), DOE/NETL-2021/2865, Case 0B. Full PDF: sources/Valentine_Zoelle_NETL_DAC_Sorbent_2022.pdf. Cost table: Exhibit 5-16, printed p. 50 (PDF p. 62). Supporting basis: §§3.5–3.6; Exhibits 5-4, 5-7, 5-13, 5-14; printed pp. 19–21, 32–35, 46–47 (PDF pp. 31–33, 44–47, 58–59).

study_conditions.configuration: Monolith sorbent DAC integrated with a natural-gas combined-cycle plant; 90% capture of NGCC flue-gas CO2; 60% capture fraction in DAC adsorbers.
study_conditions.cost_estimate_class: AACE Class 5 conceptual estimate; capital uncertainty stated as +/-50%.
study_conditions.cost_boundary: Integrated NGCC + Cansolv flue-gas capture + DAC system; includes NETL-assumed CO2 transport and saline storage. Does not quantify full construction/supply-chain lifecycle emissions, storage leakage/permanence, or a separate verification/MRV cost.
study_conditions.capacity_factor_note: The listed annual Case 0B mass flows in Exhibit 5-4 and annual variable/fuel costs in Exhibit 5-14 are at the stated 85% capacity factor. DAC100 uses these annual quantities directly; it does not multiply them by 0.85 again. Exhibit 3-6's COC equation uses CF when starting from 100%-CF flow/cost quantities.
study_conditions.source_status_note: This is a reproduction of NETL's modeled cost-of-capture boundary, not a commercial quote, a full LCA, or evidence that the stored product meets a separately verified durable-removal standard.

gross_dac_tonnes_per_year.label: Gross CO2 removed from air
gross_dac_tonnes_per_year.source: Exhibit 5-4: 113,900 t/year gross DAC removal. Already an annual quantity at 85% CF; do not multiply by CF again.

ngcc_residual_emissions_tonnes_per_year.label: Residual NGCC CO2 emitted
ngcc_residual_emissions_tonnes_per_year.source: NETL process-model outputs in Exhibits 5-4 and 5-7 report approximately 13,900–13,901 t/year; difference is source-table rounding. This plant-boundary emission is deducted from DAC gross removal in NETL's 100,000 t/year net target.

plant_co2_product_tonnes_per_year.label: Total CO2 product sent to T&S
plant_co2_product_tonnes_per_year.source: Exhibit 5-16 note: 113,900 t/year gross DAC product plus 125,090 t/year captured from NGCC flue gas. This is the T&S throughput used for the plant-gross denominator.

capital_charges_annual_usd.label: Annual capital charges (FCR × TASC)
capital_charges_annual_usd.source: Calculated directly from Exhibit 5-13 TASC of $494.258m × §3.6 FCR 0.0707. This gives $349.44/net t at 100,000 t/year, versus the independently rounded Exhibit 5-16 capital row of $349.6; see reconciliation in README/report.

fixed_om_annual_usd.label: Fixed O&M
fixed_om_annual_usd.source: Exhibit 5-14: $15,343,999 annual fixed operating cost at the Case 0B design point. Fixed cost is not multiplied by capacity factor in the COC formula.

variable_om_annual_usd.label: Variable O&M (excluding fuel)
variable_om_annual_usd.source: Exhibit 5-14: $6,143,693 annual variable O&M at the stated 85% CF. It is already capacity-factor adjusted.

fuel_annual_usd.label: Natural-gas fuel cost
fuel_annual_usd.source: Exhibit 5-14: $11,399,160 annual natural-gas cost at $4.42/MMBtu and the stated 85% CF. It is already capacity-factor adjusted.

transport_storage_annual_usd.label: CO2 transport and storage
transport_storage_annual_usd.source: Uses Exhibit 5-16's published DACnet T&S line of $23.9/net t × 100,000 net t/year = $2,390,000/year in its reported 2019-dollar table (the line is rounded to one decimal). For comparison, §3.5's $10/t Midwest assumption × 238,990 total-product t/year = $2,389,900 in 2018 dollars, $100/year lower before any dollar-year conversion. NETL does not show a conversion here; DAC100 follows the 2019-dollar table and does not invent an adjustment.

verification_annual_usd.label: Separate verification / MRV cost entered
verification_annual_usd.source: NETL Case 0B does not report a separate verification/MRV cost. Zero here means excluded from this reproduction, not demonstrated to be free.

durable_storage_fraction.label: Assumed durably stored share
durable_storage_fraction.source: Conditional assumption for the modeled CO2 product. NETL assumes pipeline-spec product and saline storage costs but does not quantify leakage, permanence, or verification; this is not a verified durable-removal fraction.

published_coc_table.source: Exhibit 5-16, printed p. 50 / PDF viewer p. 62. The table's one-decimal line items and totals are independently rounded. DAC100 calculates annual capital charges directly from the printed TASC × FCR; this yields $702.21/net t versus the published $702.4, primarily because printed TASC implies $349.44/net t capital while Exhibit 5-16 reports $349.6.

scenario_bounds_note: Exploratory analyst-set ceilings, not NETL sensitivities, validated technical limits, or claims that improvements can coexist. Scenarios apply cost reductions while holding the reported annual output, process-emissions balance, T&S requirement, and study boundary constant. They are conditional arithmetic, not process re-designs.
